decidedBy: Essenthos, 2026-10-05, read by Codex against the held Ohienko wording after the owner reported Eve on Adam's word; no person has reviewed this ruling
policy: Read the explicitly printed personal name separately from the wife mentioned beside it. These six held Ukrainian occurrences were assigned to Eve by verse-list consensus.
source: Essenthos, the Ohienko Adam occurrences in Genesis 2-4, read by Codex on 2026-10-05

rulings.why: І промовив Адам explicitly names the speaker Adam. The woman he speaks about is a different referent.
Адам та жінка його names Adam and separately his wife; the man's personal name does not identify her.

Ohienko reads 'І сховався Адам і його жінка': Адам explicitly names Adam; his wife is the separate following phrase. The verse-list consensus assigned Eve to Адам because his name recurs in verses concerning her. That co-occurrence does not make his name hers.
А Адам відказав explicitly names Adam as the speaker, who then speaks about the woman.
І назвав Адам ім'я своїй жінці: Єва distinguishes the man Adam naming his wife from the name Eve he gives her.
І пізнав Адам Єву, жінку свою explicitly names Adam and then Eve as separate people.
